scientific_integrity: Analytic step-count proof and explicit rational eight-cycle equality witness. Exact rational checker is corroborative, not the basis of the infinite proof. The full 2023 open-access text and 2021 preview/abstract were inspected, with the latter full-text limitation explicitly retained.
scientific_limitations: The exact all-orbit derivative floor applies only to branch-regular forward orbits in the stated strict two-parameter chamber; the derivative does not exist at the three branch boundaries. The 2021 source full text was not accessible for a complete priority comparison, and the period-eight witness itself is an already known periodic itinerary rather than a new discovery. No assertion of cryptographic security or global symbolic conjugacy.
title: Sharp all-orbit Lyapunov floor in a four-branch map without fixed points
